blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Image-token compression must reduce computation without hurting the semantics. We introduce Varest, guided by semantic fungibility: tokens within a coherent semantic region can be summarized coarsely, while object boundaries and literal text require finer distinctions. Object and text localizers guide variable-resolution merging, preserving spatial coverage and finer detail at boundaries and text. Learned [REL] registers then prune visual tokens after early decoder processing. Training across budgets enables one checkpoint per backbone. Across three backbones and 13 benchmarks, Varest outperforms 15 baselines in mean performance retention at every evaluated budget, retaining 86.10-92.33% of full-token performance with only 5.56% of the original layer-averaged image-token count.
blocks.zh: 图像脚本压缩必须减少计算而不会伤害语义. 我们介绍Varest, 以语义可互换性为指导: 在一个连贯的语义区域内的符号可以粗略地概括, 而对象边界和文字则需要细微的区分. 对象和文本本地化器指导可变分辨率合并,保留了边界和文本的空间覆盖和更细化的细节. 学 [REL] 注册后在早期解码器处理后再进行prune视觉符号. 跨预算的培训使每个主干部门有一个检查站。 在三个支柱和13个基准中,Varest在每一个评估预算的平均绩效保留方面超过了15个基准,保留了86.10%-92.33%的完整绩效,只有5.56%的原层平均图像记录。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Per-benchmark performance of Varest across backbones and token budgets. General VQA benchmarks stay near or above full-token under compression, while text-dense benchmarks benefit most from larger budgets.
blocks.zh: 图1:Varest跨骨干和象征性预算的每个基准业绩。 一般的VQA基准在压缩下接近或超过全部数据,而文本密集基准从更大的预算中受益最大。

blocks.en: Image-token compression reduces the substantial language-model decoder compute imposed by the hundreds or thousands of image tokens in vision-language models (VLMs). An image token may describe a small part of an object, a boundary between objects, or a few characters in a sign. Compressing these tokens requires different decisions.
blocks.zh: 图像脚本压缩减少了视觉语言模型(VLM)中成百上千的图像符号所施加的实质性语言模型解码器计算. 一个图像符号可以描述一个物体的一小部分,一个物体之间的边界,或者一个符号中的几个字符. 压缩这些符号需要不同的决定.

blocks.en: Prior work has explored merging and pruning using various signals, including feature geometry [ 4 , 1 , 7 , 20 , 10 ] , attention scores [ 35 , 36 , 5 , 34 , 38 , 32 , 28 ] , learned retention utility [ 30 ] , and object membership [ 15 ] . These are natural ways to approach compression, yet they do not respect the semantics. Pruning poses a complementary problem: removing a token hurts semantic coverage, so selection without sufficient reasoning ability through enough decoder processing often discards principal information. Merging across two neighbour objects creates an arbitrary token that loses the semantics of each. Effective compression thus requires deciding both where aggregation can preserve meaningful distinctions and when further access to image tokens can be reduced.
blocks.zh: 以前的工作探索了利用各种信号进行合并和挤压,包括地貌几何[4, 1, 7, 20, 10],注意力分数[35, 36, 5, 34, 38, 32, 28], 学得的保留用途[30], 和对象成员[15]. 这些是接近压缩的自然方式,然而却不尊重语义. Pruning带来了一个互补的问题:移除一个符号会伤害语义覆盖,因此通过足够的解码器处理来选择没有足够的推理能力往往会丢弃主信息. 跨越两个邻居对象的合并会产生任意的符号,失去每个对象的语义. 因此,有效的压缩既需要决定聚合在哪里可以保持有意义的区别,也需要决定何时可以减少进一步访问图像符号。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Overview of Varest. Object boundaries and textness are passed through the Varest tokenizer with post-projector visual tokens, which are then partitioned into K m K_{m} semantic regions and each region is merged into one image token. At layer L / 2 L/2 , 4 learned [REL] registers (the figure is not to scale) produce a score for each image token and keep the K p K_{p} image tokens that are most relevant to LLM reading. Optional adaptive halting removes all remaining image tokens once the information horizon has been detected.
blocks.zh: 图2:瓦雷斯特概况. 对象边界和文本通过 Vaest 标注符,带有投影后视觉符号,然后分割成 K m K_{m} 语义区域,每个区域合并为一个图像符号. 在L / 2 L/2 中,4个已学习的 [REL] 注册符(这个数字不是缩放的)为每个图像符号产生一个分数,并保留与 LLM 读取最相关的 K p K_{p} 图像符号. 可选的适应性停止在信息视野被检测到后会移除所有剩余的图像符号.

blocks.en: We frame this requirement through the property of a set of tokens, semantic fungibility : the set of tokens that form a person is semantically interchangeable with another person’s set from another image because we can summarize them into the abstract concept of a person. We may increase the granularity, if the token budget allows, by splitting the person into head, body, arms, and legs. Each component still has high fungibility. In contrast, a set of tokens that mixes a person and a chair lacks a linked concept and therefore has low fungibility. Text has low fungibility for literal reading, since neighbour characters can contribute different meanings. In this semantic-frequency view, compatible interiors permit heavy merging, while text and semantic transitions require finer distinctions. The principle is simple: wisely partition the image such that the total fungibility of each grouped region’s token set is maximized .
blocks.zh: 我们通过一套符号的属性来设定这一要求,语义的可互换性:组成一个人的一组符号可以和另一个人物的设定相互交换,因为我们可以将它们归纳为一个人的抽象概念。 如果象征性预算允许,我们可以通过将人分为头、身体、手臂和腿来增加颗粒性。 每个组件的可互换性仍然很高。 相比之下,一套将人和椅子混合在一起的符号缺乏关联的概念,因此可替换性较低. 文本对于文字阅读的可互换性较低,因为邻居角色可以贡献不同的含义. 在这种语义-频率视图中,兼容的内部允许重合,而文本和语义过渡则需要更细的区分. 原则很简单:明智地分割图像,

blocks.en: Varest implements this principle by combining pre-LLM semantic-preserved variable-resolution tokenization and in-LLM relevance pruning (Figure 2 ). Lightweight object and text localizers guide the merging and ensure full coverage through adjusting the semantic granularity. After early decoder layers process these tokens, learned [REL] registers retain a subset for subsequent visual access. End-to-end training across budgets enables one checkpoint per backbone; optional adaptive halting further reduces visual-token propagation.
blocks.zh: Varest通过合并LLM语义学前预留的可变分辨率符号化和LLM内相关浏览(图2 )来执行这一原则. 轻量对象和文本本地化器通过调整语义颗粒度来引导合并并确保全覆盖. 在早期解码器层处理这些令牌后,学到的[REL]登记册保留了一个子集,用于后续的视觉访问. 跨预算的端到端培训使每个主干站有一个检查站;可选的适应性停止进一步减少视控传播。

blocks.en: Our key contributions are as follows: • We introduce Varest, a semantics-preserving variable-resolution tokenizer guided by object boundaries and textness. It allocates finer details to low-fungibility regions while maintaining complete spatial coverage by controlling the semantic granularity according to the token budget. • We combine this tokenizer with learned decoder-stage selection, preserving broader visual access during early processing and retaining fewer tokens in subsequent layers. Optional adaptive halting can save further compute by dropping all image tokens after the estimated information horizon. • Across three VLM backbones (LLaVA-1.5-7B [ 18 ] , LLaVA-1.5-13B [ 18 ] , and LLaVA-NeXT-8B [ 16 ] ) and 13 benchmarks, Varest achieves the highest mean performance retention among 15 baselines at every evaluated budget with a similar or lower computational cost.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下: 我们介绍Varest,一种以对象边界和文本为指南的语义学保存可变分辨率的代号。 它通过按照符号预算控制语义颗粒,在保持完整空间覆盖的同时,将更细细的细节分配给低通力区域。 我们把这个标语器和学习的解码器级选择结合起来,在早期处理过程中保留更广泛的视觉访问,并在之后的层中保留更少的符号. 可选的适应性停顿可以通过在估计的信息视野后放下所有图像符号来进一步节省计算. • 支助 纵观三个VLM主干线(LLaVA-1.5-7B[18],LLaVA-1.5-13B[18],以及LLaVA-NEXT-8B[16])和13个基准,Varest在每一份评估预算的15个基准中实现了最高平均绩效保留,计算成本类似或较低。

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: Varest allocates visual resolution across the image and visual access across LLM decoder depth, as shown in Figure 2 . In Section 2.1 , given an image and user prompt, we first partition the image-token grid into regions guided by the object boundaries and textness. Merging within these regions produces K m K_{m} image tokens that have different resolutions but preserve full spatial coverage. Early decoder layers process this representation together with the prompt and four [REL] tokens/registers discussed in Section 2.2 . At the decoder midpoint, the registers select K p K_{p} image tokens for the rest of the LLM. The budget splitting over depth follows K m + K p 2 = K \frac{K_{m}+K_{p}}{2}=K and K m = 4 ​ K p K_{m}=4K_{p} . Optional adaptive halting in Section 2.3 , if triggered, can subsequently remove all image tokens at any point after layer 8, even before the midpoint, in which case [REL] pruning will be skipped.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,Varest通过图像分配视觉分辨率,通过LLM解码器深度分配视觉访问. 在第2.1节中,由于图像和用户提示,我们首先将图像键网格分割成以对象边界和文本为引导的区域。 这些区域内的合并产生了K m K_{m] 图像符号,其分辨率不同,但保持了全空间覆盖. 早期的解码层将这种表示与第2.2节所讨论的即时和四个[REL]符号/登记符一起处理。 在解码器中点, 登记簿为 LLM 的其余部分选择 K p K_{p} 图像符号 。 预算在深度上的划分遵循 K m + K p 2 = K\ frac{ K_{m}+K_{p}}{2}=K 和 K = 4 K p K_{m}=4K_{p}. 第2.3节中可选的适应性停止,如果被触发,可以在第8层之后的任何时候,甚至在中点之前移除所有图像符号,在这种情况下,[REL]冲刺将被跳过.

blocks.en: 2.1 Semantic Variable-Resolution Tokenization
blocks.zh: 2.1 语义变量分辨率调试

blocks.en: To maximize semantic fungibility, we prefer merging within semantic regions and preserve finer distinctions at transitions. Algorithm 1 provides a schematic. We use a lightweight object localizer to determine the semantic transitions. The semantic granularity that decides whether we further divide a car into fine-grained components like doors is bounded by the token budget. Because the literal reading of text is sensitive to any compression, we use a separate text localizer to pin all text cells at native resolution, if budget allows. The resulting partition ensures every raw token contributes to a region.
blocks.zh: 为了最大限度地实现语义的可互换性,我们倾向于在语义区域内合并,在过渡时保持更细微的区别. 算法1提供了图解. 我们使用轻量级物体定位器来确定语义的转换. 语义颗粒度决定我们是否进一步将一辆车分割成门等精细的磨损部件,以符号预算为界. 因为文字的字面阅读对任何压缩都很敏感,所以如果预算允许的话,我们使用一个单独的文字本地化器将所有文字单元格固定在本地分辨率上. 由此产生的分割确保了每一个原始的符号都为一个区域作出贡献。

blocks.en: 2.2 [REL] Relevance Pruning
blocks.zh: 2.2 [REL] 相关性跟踪

blocks.en: Inspired by PyramidDrop [ 34 ] , we expose more tokens to the early decoder layers by pruning at the midpoint, keeping the layer-averaged token budget the same. A region may have already contributed information to contextual states even if its token is later removed.
blocks.zh: 在PyramidDrop[34]的启发下,我们通过在中点钻探来向早期的解码层暴露出更多的代币,使层平均代币预算保持不变. 一个区域可能已经向背景状态提供了信息,即使其标志后来被删除。

blocks.en: For inference, we retain the K p K_{p} highest-scoring image tokens using hard top-k and remove the rest together with the [REL] registers. The pruning operation is implemented as attention masking during training, allowing gradients to flow through. It learns to be prompt-blind (see Section 4.1 ) even though the end-to-end architecture allows prompt-conditioned scoring.

blocks.en: 2.3 Optional Adaptive Halting
blocks.zh: 2.3 可选适应性停止

blocks.en: Wang et al. [ 31 ] show that VLMs have an information horizon : a layer beyond which image tokens contribute little to the output. HiDrop [ 32 ] exploits this horizon by removing all image tokens at a fixed layer, which is layer 25 for LLaVA-1.5-7B. Yet the horizon varies across tasks. Our withdrawal study shows that OCR has the latest horizon near the end of the LLM (later than layer 25 on LLaVA-1.5-7B); therefore, a fixed cutoff can retain image tokens unnecessarily for some inputs while removing useful visual evidence too early for others.
blocks.zh: Wang et al. [31] 显示VLM有信息视野: a 层,超过层,图像符号对输出的贡献很小。 HiDrop [32] 利用这个地平线,在固定的地层中去除所有图像符号,对于LLaVA-1.5-7B来说是25层. 然而,各种任务的视野各不相同。 我们的退出研究显示,OCR在LLM的末端有最新的视野(后来比LLaVA-1.5-7B上的第25层),因此,固定的截断可以不必要地保留一些输入的图像符号,同时过早地去除其他输入的有用的视觉证据.

blocks.en: 2.4 Training and Budget Control
blocks.zh: 2.4 培训和预算控制

blocks.en: We optimize the registers, scoring head, multimodal projector, spatial tags, and LoRA [ 9 ] adapters in the vision and language stacks and vocabulary head using teacher-forced answer cross-entropy, on the VLM’s own tuning dataset. The localizers remain frozen, and no token-relevance labels are required. A straight-through sigmoid surrogate supplies gradients to the selector [ 3 ] . We vary the merging budget during training and sample the pruning count from zero through the realized merging count. This allows one checkpoint per backbone to serve all budgets.
blocks.zh: 我们利用教师强制的回答交叉操作,在VLM自己的调制数据集上优化视线、语言堆栈和词汇头中的登记、记分、多式投影仪、空间标记和LORA[9]适配器。 本地化器仍然冷冻,不需要标志性标签. 直通Sigmoid代词向选择器提供梯度[3]. 我们在培训期间将合并预算加以改动,并抽查从零到实现合并的数。 这使每个主干单位有一个检查站为所有预算服务。

This count excludes text tokens and the four registers. For LLaVA-1.5, the retained ratio is r = K / 576 r=K/576 . For LLaVA-NeXT, we apply the requested ratio to each image’s native sequence length, so realized integer counts vary with image resolution.

blocks.en: 3 Related Work
blocks.zh: 3 相关工作

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Compression signals and stages. Arrows progress toward explicit semantic priors. Varest preserves semantic structure and text detail before pruning inside the LLM.
blocks.zh: 图4:压缩信号和相位. 箭向明确的语义前缀前进。 Varest)在LLM内部伸展前保留语义结构和文字细节.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Visualization of tokenization and [REL] pruning across budgets on LLaVA-1.5-7B. For each K K , the left panel shows the tokenization (text tokens in orange) and the right panel shows the tokens kept by [REL] . Text remains identifiable at every budget, while semantic granularity becomes finer as K K increases.
blocks.zh: 图5:LLaVA-1.5-7B的标志化和[REL]跨预算的可视化。 对于每个 K K , 左面板显示符号化( 橙色的文本符号) , 右面板显示 [REL] 保存的符号 。 文字在每一个预算中都仍然可以识别,而语义颗粒性随着K K 的增加而变得更细.

blocks.en: We categorize visual-token compression signals into semantic [ 15 ] , saliency [ 4 , 35 , 1 , 36 , 7 , 20 ] , and query cues [ 5 , 38 , 34 , 10 , 28 , 30 , 32 ] , as shown in Figure 4 . Saliency cues estimate importance or redundancy from the image alone. ToMe [ 4 ] merges similar features, while VisionZip [ 35 ] retains attention-ranked tokens and aggregates the remaining context. These image-only criteria permit compression before the prompt is processed, but do not explicitly account for object boundaries or the finer detail needed to read text. Query cues use language context to prioritize content needed for a particular question, as in SparseVLM [ 38 ] . This directs the budget toward task-relevant evidence. When derived from decoder attention, however, these cues depend on decoder processing, and attention reliability can vary across layers [ 30 ] . Semantic cues add explicit content structure to constrain grouping, helping specify which features can be summarized together. Varest combines semantic-guided token allocation within an image with depth-wise budget allocation, using variable-resolution tokenization and learned decoder-stage selection.
blocks.zh: 如图4所示,我们把视觉式压缩信号分为语义[15]、显性[4、35、1、36、7、20]和查询提示[5、38、34、10、28、30、32]。 显著提示从图像中估算出重要性或冗余值。 ToMe [4] 合并了类似的特征,而VisionZip [35] 保留了被关注排序的符号,并汇总了剩余上下文. 这些只使用图像的标准允许在处理提示前进行压缩,但没有明确说明对象边界或读取文本所需的更细的细节. 如SparseVLM [38]. 这使得预算转向与任务相关的证据。 然而,当从解码器的注意中导出时,这些提示依赖于解码器的处理,而注意的可靠性可能因层而异[30]. 语义提示添加了明确的内容结构来约束分组,帮助指定哪些特性可以一起归纳. Varest将图像内部的语义引导符号分配与深度导向预算分配相结合,使用可变分辨率符号化和学习解码器阶段选择.

blocks.en: Within an image, semantic priors guide how a token budget is distributed nonuniformly across regions. CORE [ 15 ] guides pooling with object masks and orders the resulting tokens by their centroids, preserving object membership and spatial layout. A limitation of CORE’s object-based pooling is that it does not explicitly allocate finer resolution to text within an object. Varest’s variable-resolution tokenizer addresses this through semantic fungibility, using boundary and textness cues to allocate resolution. It separates detected text from its surrounding object, allowing coarse object summaries alongside finer text representations. Detected text remains at native patch-grid resolution when the budget permits.
blocks.zh: 在图像中,语义学前科指导象征性预算如何在各区域之间统一分配。 CORE [15] 向导用物体口罩集合,并按其中心机器人订购产生的符号,保留物体的会籍和空间布局. CORE基于对象的集合的一个限制是,它没有明确将更精细的分辨率分配给对象内的文字. Varest 的可变分辨率比喻器通过语义可互换, 使用边界和文本提示来分配分辨率。 它将检测到的文字与其周围物体区分开来,允许粗细的物体摘要与更细的文字表达. 在预算允许的情况下,检测到的文本仍然处于本地补丁网解析状态。

blocks.en: Across decoder depth, the complementary question is how long visual tokens remain available. Multi-stage methods [ 34 , 28 , 30 ] use larger budgets early and fewer tokens later, allowing contextual processing before pruning. DUET-VLM [ 28 ] and LearnPruner [ 30 ] combine this with pre-LLM reduction. Varest follows this depth-wise allocation but differs in selection. LearnPruner learns early patch selection but uses text-to-image attention to prune visual tokens in a middle decoder layer. However, attention does not necessarily reflect a token’s influence on the prediction. In NLP models, Jain and Wallace [ 13 ] find that attention weights can correlate poorly with gradient-based importance and that different attention distributions can yield similar predictions. Rather than using attention weights as an importance proxy, Varest learns a relevance score for each semantic region through [REL] registers and a scoring head. This adapts the retention criterion to contextualized, variable-resolution semantic region representations.
blocks.zh: 从解码深度来看,补充的问题是视觉符号还存在多久。 多阶段方法[34,28,30]早期使用更大的预算,后期使用更少的代币,允许先进行上下文处理后再进行推敲. DUET-VLM [28] 和 LearnPruner [30] 将此与LLM前还原结合. Varest遵循这种深度分配,但在选择上有所不同. LearnPruner学习早期的补丁选择,但在中间解码层使用文本到图像的注意度来表示prune视觉符号. 然而,关注并不一定反映象征对预测的影响。 在NLP模型中,Jain和Wallace [13] 发现关注权重可能与梯度重要性关系不佳,不同的关注分布可以产生类似的预测. Varest不是将注意力权重作为重要的代名词,而是通过[REL]注册和一个评分头来学习每个语义区的相关分数. 这使得保留标准适应了背景化的,可变分辨率的语义区域表述.

blocks.zh: 4 实验

Varest achieves the highest retention at every evaluated budget across all three backbones, preserving over 85% performance at r = 5.56 % r=5.56\% on all three VLMs.

blocks.en: Figure 7 : [REL] pruning behaviour under different prompts on LLaVA-1.5-7B. Varest keeps nearly the same tokens for two unrelated questions, yet answers both correctly, even when the named object is discarded.

blocks.en: We first visually inspect the tokenization and pruning behaviours in Section 4.1 . Across three backbones, Section 4.2 evaluates Varest against 15 baselines on MMBench [ 19 ] , AI2D [ 14 ] , MMStar [ 6 ] , POPE [ 17 ] (three metrics), GQA [ 11 ] , ChartQA [ 22 ] , DocVQA [ 23 ] , TextVQA [ 29 ] , RefCOCO/RefCOCO+ [ 37 ] , RefCOCOg [ 21 ] , CountBench [ 25 ] , and V* [ 33 ] . Adaptive halting is disabled except in Section 4.3 , where we test its performance. Section 4.4 analyzes the efficiency, and Section 4.5 isolates the contributions of each component.
blocks.zh: 我们首先查看第4.1节中的象征性行为和掠夺行为。 第4.2节通过三个支柱进行评价 在MMBench [19], AI2D [14], MMStar [6], POPE [17] (三公尺), GQA [11], ChartQA [22], DocVQA [23], TextVQA [29], RefCO/RefCOCO+ [37], RefCOg [21], Bench伯爵 [25],和 V* [33] 上以15个基线进行变异. 除第4.3节外,适应性停止是被禁止的,我们在该节测试其性能。 第4.4节分析了效率,第4.5节孤立了每个构成部分的贡献。

blocks.en: 4.1 Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.1 定性分析

blocks.en: As shown in Figures 3 and 5 , Varest clearly identifies text cells (highlighted in orange) during tokenization. Combined with the context from merged object tokens, this allows LLaVA-1.5-7B to reach the correct answer at very small budgets ( K = 32 K=32 ). Other methods such as HiDrop [ 32 ] and LearnPruner [ 30 ] are prompt-sensitive and correctly identify the needed text, but at low budgets they lack the object localization to provide the surrounding context.
blocks.zh: 如图3和图5所示,Varest在标注时明确识别文字单元格(以橙色显示)。 结合合并对象符的上下文,这使得LLaVA-1.5-7B能够在非常小的预算(K=32 K=32)中达到正确的答案. HiDrop [32] 和LearnPruner [30] 等其他方法对所需的文本具有即时敏感性并正确识别,但在低预算时它们缺乏对象本地化以提供周边上下文.

blocks.en: In our analysis, we find that Varest allocates resolution as needed across token budgets while preserving identifiable semantic information. As shown in Figure 5 , even low-resolution tokenizations remain interpretable, with distinct boundaries between objects and other regions. Furthermore, Varest identifies text at every budget and consistently retains the information needed for OCR and other text-based tasks. Notably, Varest answers the bottom question correctly even though the named tokens are not kept by [REL] . Figure 7 confirms that this learned relevance reflects LLM reading, not prompt sensitivity. This implies their information has already been absorbed in the early layers, before pruning, and prompt sensitivity is not necessary.
blocks.zh: 在我们的分析中,我们发现,瓦雷斯特在保存可识别的语义信息的同时,根据需要将分辨率分配给象征性预算。 如图5所示,即使低分辨率的标语仍然可以解释,对象与其他区域之间有不同的界限。 此外,Varest确定每个预算的文本,并始终保留OCR和其他文本任务所需的信息。 值得注意的是,Varest正确地回答了底层问题,尽管所命名的符号不是由[REL]保存的. 图7证实,这种了解的关联性反映了LLM读数,而不是即时的敏感性. 这意味着它们的信息已经在早期层中被吸收了,在钻探之前,并且不需要迅速的敏感性.

blocks.en: 4.2 Quantitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.2 定量分析

blocks.en: Table 1 : Benchmark-averaged retention rates. We evaluate the average retention rate with respect to the uncompressed model of each method on 13 benchmarks across VQA, OCR, and grounding. Varest outperforms all 15 baselines at every budget across all three backbones, retaining 86.10 86.10 – 92.33 % 92.33\% of baseline performance at the lowest budgets.

Varest achieves higher retention with slightly less computation than HiDrop, the strongest baseline by mean retention. Adaptive halting (AH) further reduces computation with a small retention loss.

blocks.en: We report mean performance retention by normalizing each metric against the corresponding uncompressed backbone and averaging over 15 metrics, with the three POPE variants counted separately. Comparisons use layer-averaged image-token budgets; 100% retention means matching the uncompressed model.
blocks.zh: 我们报告说,通过使每个指标与相应的未压缩骨干相对照实现正常化,并平均超过15个指标,实现绩效保留,其中三个POPE变量分别计算。 比较使用层平均图像键预算;100%保留意味着匹配未压缩模型.

blocks.en: Figure 6 and Table 1 show that Varest achieves the highest mean retention at every evaluated budget across all three backbones. At the smallest token ratio of 5.56%, it retains 86.10–92.33% of uncompressed performance. More importantly, at an 11.11% token ratio, Varest outperforms every baseline evaluated at 22.22% on all three backbones. For example, on LLaVA-1.5-7B, it achieves 97.08% retention at K = 64 K=64 , exceeding the strongest baseline’s 94.50% at K = 128 K=128 . At K = 128 K=128 , both LLaVA-1.5 models reach approximately 100% retention, matching uncompressed performance with 22.22% of the tokens.
blocks.zh: 图6和表1显示,Varest在所有三个主干单位的每个经评价的预算中,平均留存额最高。 按5.56%的最小象征性比率,它保留了86.10-92.33%的未压缩性能. 更重要的是,按11.11%的象征性比率,Varest在所有三个骨干上都超过了22.22%的每个基线。 例如,在LLaVA-1.5-7B上,在K=64 K=64时达到97.08%的保留率,在K=128 K=128时超过了最强基线的94.50%。 在K = 128 K = 128时,LLaVA-1.5两种型号都达到了约100%的保留,将未压缩的性能与22.22%的令牌相匹配.

blocks.en: Figure 1 shows that the required budget varies across tasks. General VQA performance remains relatively stable as the budget decreases, whereas document reading, chart understanding, and referring-expression grounding benefit more from larger budgets.
blocks.zh: 图1显示所需预算因任务而异。 随着预算的减少,总的VQA业绩仍然相对稳定,而文件阅读、图表理解和参考表达基础则更多地受益于更大的预算。

blocks.en: 4.4 Efficiency Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4 效率分析

blocks.en: Figure 8 compares performance retention and measured computation, each averaged over four budgets. Across the three backbones, Varest improves retention over HiDrop, the strongest baseline, by 3.79–6.39 percentage points while using 1.0–4.7% fewer FLOPs. Its accuracy advantage therefore persists when accounting for measured computation. Latency heavily depends on the code implementation and is therefore not a reliable metric and not reported.
blocks.zh: 图8比较了绩效保留和计量计算,每个预算平均超过四个预算。 纵观三个骨干,Varest将比HiDrop(最强基线)的留存率提高3.79-6.39个百分点,同时使用1.0-4.7%的FLOP。 因此,在计算计量值时,其准确性优势依然存在。 延迟在很大程度上取决于守则的执行,因此不是一个可靠的衡量标准,也没有报告。

blocks.en: Adaptive halting further reduces FLOPs by 3.0–5.1%, with retention losses of 0.30–0.48 percentage points. It provides an additional tradeoff between compute and accuracy. Both settings use the same checkpoint, so this tradeoff can be adjusted at inference without additional training or model storage.
blocks.zh: 适应性停止进一步将FLOP减少3.0–5.1%,留存损失0.30–0.48个百分点. 它在计算和准确性之间提供了额外的权衡. 两种设置都使用相同的检查点,因此这种权衡可以推论调整,而无需额外的训练或模型存储.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: Varest uses semantic fungibility to allocate resolution, summarizing compatible regions while reserving finer representations for text and object boundaries. By maintaining full spatial coverage before decoder-stage pruning, it allows early decoder layers to integrate scene context before reducing subsequent visual access. The method remains compatible with FlashAttention [ 8 ] , since token selection does not require decoder attention weights, although translating computational savings into lower latency also requires an efficient implementation. Adapting Varest to additional VLM families, such as Qwen-VL and InternVL, remains promising future work. More broadly, the same semantic fungibility principle could extend beyond natural images. For example, in medical images, healthy organs are like objects and lesions are like text. Such extensions require domain-specific validation, but have great potential.
blocks.zh: Varest使用语义的可互换性来分配分辨率,总结兼容区域,同时为文本和对象边界保留更细的表示. 通过在解码器级普鲁恩前保持全空间覆盖,它允许早期解码器层在减少后续的视觉访问之前整合场景上下文. 该方法仍然与FlashAttenty [8]兼容,因为符号选择不需要解码器的注意权重,尽管将计算节省转化为更低的延迟也需要高效执行. 使瓦斯特适应其他VLM家庭,如Quen-VL和InternVL,仍然是未来有希望的工作。 更广泛地说,同样的语义可互换性原则可以超越自然图像. 例如,在医学影像中,健康的器官像物体,损伤像文字. 这种扩展需要特定域的验证,但具有巨大的潜力.
